executionNotes: Consolidated independent results, not a claim that all cases ran in one uninterrupted final pass. Original attempt logs preserved.

Exact reload bitmap hashing was narrowed to pixel comparison: same equipped ball, same dimensions and same alpha bounds, maximum channel delta 1/255. A broad hash-equality assertion overconstrained canvas readback.

The first broad run passed animation sampling. The second broad run sampled an unchanged initial transform during viewport movement. The focused run explicitly completed instantaneous scrolling to scrollY=0, recorded a non-pending running animation, and verified changing animation currentTime/transform with stable canvas bitmaps. Product source unchanged.

Actual Chromium scrolling + IntersectionObserver and native mouse down/up verified. Hidden/visible state test uses controlled document properties/events because a second headless tab leaves the first visible.
Only fixture APIs were used. Browser and Vite server closed in all attempts; existing port 8000 and real user state untouched.
